last_checked.description: Date and time of the last metadata check, conforming to RFC 3339.

sources.description: List of URLs that were used for metadata discovery, such as API URLs or PR URLs for manual edits.

metadata.description: Common metadata fields shared across artifacts, services, instantiations, and repositories.
metadata.title: Common Metadata

topics.description: List of topic or categories associated with the resource.

vendor.description: Name of the distributing entity, organization, or individual.

version.description: Version. The version may match a label or tag in the source code repository or may be Semantic Versioning-compatible.

fork_of.description: URL to the entity this is a fork of.

discussion_url.description: Link to issue, PR/MR, or discussion about this definition.

source_url.description: Informal pointer to source code. Use when deployment information is not available.

source_ref.description: Informal pointer to source ref (branch or tag name).

source_revision.description: Informal pointer to source code revision. Use when deployment information is not available.

spdx_licenses.description: License(s) as an SPDX License Expression.

created.description: Date and time on which the resource was created, conforming to RFC 3339.

typeRef.title: Type Ref
typeRef.description: Type references with optional constraints. Keys are type names, values are either null or objects with constraint properties such as version.

metadata.description: Additional metadata about the type reference.

model.description: URL of artifact or service model that constrains this type reference.

properties.description: Constraints on instance properties that are associated with the type. Actual interpretation of properties is entirely up to the type definition.

status.description: Status of the instance or capability.

typedURLs.description: Map of URLs with optional type references. Keys are URLs, values are type references with optional constraints or "metadata".

release_schedule.title: Release Schedule
release_schedule.description: Scheduled Release for an artifact or service.

url.description: The updated resource URL for this upcoming release.

effective_date.description: The date and time the release will happen (RFC 3339 format).

type.description: Type identifier from types/artifacts with optional version constraints.

contains.description: Map of URLs of interesting artifacts that this artifact embeds or incorporates.

references.description: (Build-time or run-time) Map of URLs of interesting artifacts, repositories or services that this artifact may reference when executed or instantiated.

instantiates.description: Map of URLs (or labels) of entities (e.g., software package, service image or template, capabilities pipeline, build tools) that this artifact instantiates with optional type constraints.

dependencies.description: Build-time or run-time, dependencies the user may provide or configure. if url, it could be service use needs an account on or a default. Software, services, or environment context that the instantiation may depend on. Keys are labels or URLs, values are type constraints of components or capabilities. Non-exhaustive: for example, the artifact type may imply additional requirements or some dependencies might be optional.

instantiated_by.description: URLs referencing instantiations that created or validated this artifact.

tags.description: List of available tags for this artifact (e.g., container image tags).

immutable.description: Indicates whether the artifact identifier refers to an artifact that will not change.

platforms.description: List of platforms this artifact supports.

versions.description: Artifacts that are variants of this artifact (for example, releases or snapshots). Each artifact inherits the metadata of this one unless overridden in its declaration. Identifiers should share the base ID as this package. If versions share the same digest, the artifact identifier refers to the same physical artifact, such as a tagged container image.

propertyNames.description: A PURL identifier or another URL if the artifact is of a type not supported by PURL.

type.description: Type identifier from types/services with optional version constraints.

access.description: Access to the service (who can resolve the URL).

connections.description: Services this service connects to during operation.

spdx_licenses.description: License(s) under which the service is distributed as an SPDX License Expression.

terms_of_service.description: URL to the terms of service.

instantiated_by.description: URLs referencing instantiations that created or validated this service.

versions.description: Services that are variants of this service (for example, different versions or environments). Each service inherits the metadata of this one unless overridden in its declaration. Identifiers should share the base URL as this service.

digest.description: Cryptographic digest of the document referenced by the instantiation URL.

revision.description: If instantiation URL references a repository, source control revision of that repository.

source_ref.description: If source URL references a repository, the branch or tag name.

source_revision.description: If source URL references a repository, the source control revision of that repository.

instantiated.description: The artifacts or services created or updated by this instantiation with optional capability.

inputs.description: The artifact, instantiation, service, or repository URLs that were consumed or referenced as part of the instantiation process.

metadata.description: Additional information about the instantiation, expected contents depends on the instantiation artifact type.

versions.description: Instantiations that are variants of this instantiation (for example, different deployments or environments). Each instantiation inherits the metadata of this one unless overridden in its declaration.

path.description: Project path relative to base location of git repositories on the host.

initial_revision.description: Initial commit of the default branch.

service.description: URL of the service hosting this repository.

protocols.description: List of protocols available to clone the repository (e.g., https, ssh).

internal_id.description: Internal identifier from the repository host (e.g., GitHub repository ID).

project_url.description: URL to the repository's project page on the host (e.g., <https://github.com/user/repo>).

mirror_of.description: URL of the repository that this repository is a mirror of.

fork_of.description: URL of the repository that this repository was forked from.

private.description: True if the repository is not publicly accessible.

metadata.description: Metadata about the repository that isn't stored in the git repository itself but might be provided by the host (e.g., metadata found on the repository's GitHub or GitLab project page).

license_url.description: URL to the license file or license information.

issues_url.description: URL to the issue tracker for the repository.

lastupdate_time.description: Timestamp of the last metadata update.

lastupdate_digest.description: Digest hash of the metadata at the time of the last update.

project_status.description: Project status as defined by https://www.repostatus.org

branches.description: Map of branch names to their commit SHA hashes.

additionalProperties.description: Commit SHA hash for the branch.

tags.description: Map of tag names to their commit SHA hashes.

additionalProperties.description: Commit SHA hash for the tag.

contains.description: Map of artifact URLs (for files or directories in the repository) that are useful for characterizing the repository and integrating it with the other resources in the cloud map, with optional type constraints.

kind.description: The kind of the type. One of: Component, Artifact, or Capability.

implementations.description: Non-exhaustive list URLs to repositories or artifacts that implement this type.

status.description: Maturity level of the type definition.

model.description: URL of artifact or service to use a model for instances of this type.

source.description: Artifact containing type definition. Include if it cannot be derived from the type name.

extends.description: List of fully-qualified type names that this type extends.

repositories.description: Git repositories. Keys are URLs that start with git://

propertyNames.description: URL of the repository using the git:// URL scheme.

artifacts.description: Tangible object that instantiates services or other artifacts. Artifact ID is either a package URL (see <https://github.com/package-url/purl-spec>) or repository URL with path.

propertyNames.description: A PURL identifier or another URL if the artifact is of a type not supported by PURL.

instantiations.description: Build and deployment information for artifacts and services. Keys are URLs.

types.description: Type definitions for artifacts, services, software, and capabilities.

propertyNames.description: Fully-qualified type name with namespace (e.g., Compute@unfurl.cloud/onecommons/std).
